capabilities: Assign background colors to open tabs from the tab's right-click context menu
Choose among seven shades of a palette color via a submenu
Persist color assignments across restarts and write the color name to YAML frontmatter
Open back/forward history destinations in a new tab with Ctrl/Cmd-click
Customize palette names and colors and enforce WCAG 2.1 text contrast
extras: Colors are stored by writing a lowercase palette name to YAML frontmatter for Markdown files; non-Markdown files keep colors in memory only and are not modified. Settings include options to prevent tab duplication and to remove a color when the last tab of a file closes.
motivation: The README explains that visual color tagging lets you cycle through open notes faster and reduces mental overhead during researching, cross-referencing, or writing.
problem: When working with several notes open at once, it is hard to quickly tell tabs apart and jump to the right one.
summary: Adds a right-click context menu option that colors open tab backgrounds, with shade selection, custom palettes, and persistence in note frontmatter.
